einzeiler: Baseball debate on the NL MVP race, a bizarre absence in Arizona, and MLB trivia.
kurzfassung: The hosts play a game of StatPad focusing on player RBIs and welcome baseball expert Daniel Álvarez to discuss the American League wildcard race and the NL MVP battle between Pete Crow-Armstrong and Shohei Ohtani. They also address the strange situation surrounding Ketel Marte's sudden absence for the Diamondbacks and highlight standout performers. Finally, the episode wraps up with the thrilling conclusion of the trivia game won by Jeremy.
stichpunkte: The hosts play the StatPad trivia game focused on player RBIs, featuring historic player stats across various categories.
Guest Daniel Álvarez joins the show to discuss the competitive and somewhat mediocre American League wildcard race.
The discussion touches on the surprising success of the Baltimore Orioles and their recent addition of Pete Alonso.
The hosts and Álvarez examine the bizarre situation surrounding Ketel Marte failing to show up for the Diamondbacks.
The debate centers on whether Pete Crow-Armstrong should win the National League MVP over Shohei Ohtani.
Álvarez highlights Gabriel Moreno as his star of the week for his exceptional performance with the Diamondbacks.
The trivia game concludes with Jeremy narrowly defeating Chris Cody after a tense discussion over Oakland Athletics history.
beschreibung:
Daniel Álvarez of El Extrabase joins Jeremy this week to answer the question that is sweeping the baseball world right now: Who should win the NL MVP, Pete Crow-Armstrong or Shohei Ohtani? He also weighs in on the developing situation between Ketel Marte and the Arizona Diamondbacks. In this week's game, Chris and Jeremy face off in another edition of Statpad. Will we ever know the score between these two on the season?
